Lab reports from Harvey Mudd's Microprocessor-Based Systems: Design and
Applications (ENGR155), taught by Profs. Josh Brake and Matt Spencer in Fall
2026. The labs build systems on a Lattice iCE40UP5K FPGA (UPduino v3.1) and
an STM32L432KC microcontroller (Nucleo-L432KC), with RTL design in
SystemVerilog, simulation in QuestaSim, synthesis in Lattice Radiant, and
embedded C in SEGGER Embedded Studio. Later labs cover digital audio,
interrupts, SPI and the Internet of Things, and an AES hardware accelerator,
and the semester ends with a team-designed FPGA and microcontroller project.
